payload.content:
name: satcom-release-poisoning
description: 'Hybrid supply-chain exercise for a satellite communications platform.
  The scenario models build compromise, signed artifact poisoning, release promotion,
  tenant isolation risk, and rollback under live telemetry pressure.

  '
nodes:
  internet-edge:
    type: switch
    description: Public and partner ingress
  corp-eng:
    type: switch
    description: Engineering workstations and forge access
  build-net:
    type: switch
    description: CI runner and registry network
  control-net:
    type: switch
    description: Satellite control plane
  edge-net:
    type: switch
    description: Regional edge gateways
  telemetry-net:
    type: switch
    description: Telemetry collection and streaming
  federation-net:
    type: switch
    description: Customer and vendor federation boundary
  security-net:
    type: switch
    description: Monitoring and response systems
  git-forge:
    type: compute
    source:
      name: git-forge
      version: '*'
    resources:
      ram: 4294967296
      cpu: 2
    os: linux
    features:
      git-service: forge-admin
    conditions:
      repo-integrity-healthy: forge-admin
    roles:
      forge-admin:
        username: forgeadmin
        entities:
        - platform-blue.release-engineering
    services:
    - port: 443
      name: forge-https
    - port: 22
      name: forge-ssh
  ci-runner:
    type: compute
    source:
      name: ci-runner
      version: '*'
    resources:
      ram: 4294967296
      cpu: 4
    os: linux
    features:
      ci-orchestrator: ci-admin
    conditions:
      pipeline-green: ci-admin
      rogue-release-promoted: ci-admin
    roles:
      ci-admin:
        username: gitlab-runner
    services:
    - port: 443
      name: ci-api
    - port: 2222
      name: ci-ssh
  artifact-registry:
    type: compute
    source:
      name: artifact-registry
      version: '*'
    resources:
      ram: 4294967296
      cpu: 2
    os: linux
    features:
      release-registry: registry-admin
    conditions:
      release-signature-valid: registry-admin
      rollback-package-ready: registry-admin
    roles:
      registry-admin:
        username: registry
        entities:
        - platform-blue.release-engineering
    services:
    - port: 5000
      name: registry-api
    - port: 443
      name: registry-ui
  signing-hsm:
    type: compute
    source:
      name: signing-service
      version: '*'
    resources:
      ram: 2147483648
      cpu: 2
    os: linux
    features:
      signing-service: signing-admin
    conditions:
      signing-health: signing-admin
    roles:
      signing-admin:
        username: signer
    services:
    - port: 8443
      name: signing-api
  control-api:
    type: compute
    source:
      name: satcom-control-plane
      version: '*'
    resources:
      ram: 6442450944
      cpu: 4
    os: linux
    features:
      satcom-control: control-admin
    conditions:
      control-plane-healthy: control-admin
      rollback-complete: control-admin
    roles:
      control-admin:
        username: satops
        entities:
        - platform-blue.sre
    services:
    - port: 443
      name: control-api
    - port: 8444
      name: control-admin-ui
    asset_value:
      integrity: critical
      availability: critical
  edge-gateway-east:
    type: compute
    source:
      name: satcom-edge
      version: '*'
    resources:
      ram: 2147483648
      cpu: 2
    os: linux
    features:
      edge-agent-east: edge-admin
    conditions:
      edge-east-healthy: edge-admin
      edge-east-poisoned: edge-admin
    roles:
      edge-admin:
        username: edgeeast
    services:
    - port: 443
      name: edge-east-api
  edge-gateway-west:
    type: compute
    source:
      name: satcom-edge
      version: '*'
    resources:
      ram: 2147483648
      cpu: 2
    os: linux
    features:
      edge-agent-west: edge-admin
    conditions:
      edge-west-healthy: edge-admin
      edge-west-poisoned: edge-admin
    roles:
      edge-admin:
        username: edgewest
    services:
    - port: 443
      name: edge-west-api
  telemetry-broker:
    type: compute
    source:
      name: kafka-broker
      version: '*'
    resources:
      ram: 4294967296
      cpu: 2
    os: linux
    features:
      telemetry-bus: telemetry-admin
    conditions:
      telemetry-flowing: telemetry-admin
    roles:
      telemetry-admin:
        username: telemetry
    services:
    - port: 9092
      name: telemetry-kafka
    - port: 443
      name: telemetry-ui
  analytics-lake:
    type: compute
    source:
      name: analytics-lake
      version: '*'
    resources:
      ram: 4294967296
      cpu: 2
    os: linux
    features:
      analytics-store: lake-admin
    conditions:
      analytics-ingest-healthy: lake-admin
    roles:
      lake-admin:
        username: lake
    services:
    - port: 443
      name: analytics-ui
  customer-portal:
    type: compute
    source:
      name: customer-portal
      version: '*'
    resources:
      ram: 4294967296
      cpu: 2
    os: linux
    features:
      customer-portal-app: portal-admin
    conditions:
      tenant-isolation-healthy: portal-admin
      portal-sso-healthy: portal-admin
    roles:
      portal-admin:
        username: portal
        entities:
        - platform-blue.release-engineering
    services:
    - port: 443
      name: portal-https
  support-bastion:
    type: compute
    source:
      name: support-bastion
      version: '*'
    resources:
      ram: 2147483648
      cpu: 2
    os: linux
    conditions:
      support-bastion-online: support-admin
    roles:
      support-admin:
        username: support
        entities:
        - vendor-ops
    services:
    - port: 22
      name: bastion-ssh
    - port: 443
      name: bastion-web
  siem01:
    type: compute
    source:
      name: siem-stack
      version: '*'
    resources:
      ram: 8589934592
      cpu: 4
    os: linux
    features:
      siem-core: soc-admin
      release-edr: soc-admin
    conditions:
      security-pipeline-healthy: soc-admin
      release-incident-ticketed: soc-admin
    roles:
      soc-admin:
        username: socadmin
        entities:
        - platform-blue.soc
    services:
    - port: 5601
      name: release-soc-ui
  vendor-idp:
    type: compute
    source:
      name: vendor-idp
      version: '*'
    resources:
      ram: 2147483648
      cpu: 1
    os: linux
    features:
      vendor-sso: idp-admin
    conditions:
      vendor-federation-healthy: idp-admin
    roles:
      idp-admin:
        username: vendorauth
    services:
    - port: 443
      name: vendor-idp-https
  customer-idp:
    type: compute
    source:
      name: customer-idp
      version: '*'
    resources:
      ram: 2147483648
      cpu: 1
    os: linux
    features:
      customer-sso: idp-admin
    conditions:
      customer-federation-healthy: idp-admin
    roles:
      idp-admin:
        username: customerauth
    services:
    - port: 443
      name: customer-idp-https
infrastructure:
  internet-edge:
    count: 1
    properties:
      cidr: 10.90.0.0/24
      gateway: 10.90.0.1
  corp-eng:
    count: 1
    properties:
      cidr: 10.90.1.0/24
      gateway: 10.90.1.1
      internal: true
  build-net:
    count: 1
    properties:
      cidr: 10.90.2.0/24
      gateway: 10.90.2.1
      internal: true
    acls:
    - name: allow-engineering-release
      direction: in
      from_net: corp-eng
      protocol: tcp
      ports:
      - 22
      - 443
      - 5000
      action: allow
    - name: deny-public-build
      direction: in
      from_net: internet-edge
      action: deny
  control-net:
    count: 1
    properties:
      cidr: 10.90.3.0/24
      gateway: 10.90.3.1
      internal: true
  edge-net:
    count: 1
    properties:
      cidr: 10.90.4.0/24
      gateway: 10.90.4.1
      internal: true
  telemetry-net:
    count: 1
    properties:
      cidr: 10.90.5.0/24
      gateway: 10.90.5.1
      internal: true
  federation-net:
    count: 1
    properties:
      cidr: 10.90.6.0/24
      gateway: 10.90.6.1
  security-net:
    count: 1
    properties:
      cidr: 10.90.7.0/24
      gateway: 10.90.7.1
      internal: true
  git-forge:
    count: 1
    links:
    - corp-eng
    - build-net
  ci-runner:
    count: 1
    links:
    - build-net
    - security-net
    dependencies:
    - git-forge
    - artifact-registry
  artifact-registry:
    count: 1
    links:
    - build-net
    - control-net
    dependencies:
    - signing-hsm
  signing-hsm:
    count: 1
    links:
    - build-net
  control-api:
    count: 1
    links:
    - control-net
    - edge-net
    - telemetry-net
    dependencies:
    - artifact-registry
    - telemetry-broker
  edge-gateway-east:
    count: 1
    links:
    - edge-net
    - telemetry-net
    dependencies:
    - control-api
  edge-gateway-west:
    count: 1
    links:
    - edge-net
    - telemetry-net
    dependencies:
    - control-api
  telemetry-broker:
    count: 1
    links:
    - telemetry-net
    - security-net
    dependencies:
    - analytics-lake
  analytics-lake:
    count: 1
    links:
    - telemetry-net
  customer-portal:
    count: 1
    links:
    - internet-edge
    - federation-net
    - control-net
    dependencies:
    - vendor-idp
    - customer-idp
  support-bastion:
    count: 1
    links:
    - internet-edge
    - federation-net
    - control-net
  siem01:
    count: 1
    links:
    - security-net
    - corp-eng
  vendor-idp:
    count: 1
    links:
    - federation-net
  customer-idp:
    count: 1
    links:
    - federation-net
features:
  git-service:
    type: service
    source:
      name: gitea-enterprise
      version: '*'
  ci-orchestrator:
    type: service
    source:
      name: gitlab-runner
      version: '*'
  release-registry:
    type: service
    source:
      name: harbor-registry
      version: '*'
  signing-service:
    type: service
    source:
      name: notation-signer
      version: '*'
  satcom-control:
    type: service
    source:
      name: satcom-control-api
      version: '*'
  edge-agent-east:
    type: service
    source:
      name: edge-control-agent
      version: '*'
  edge-agent-west:
    type: service
    source:
      name: edge-control-agent
      version: '*'
  telemetry-bus:
    type: service
    source:
      name: kafka
      version: '*'
  analytics-store:
    type: service
    source:
      name: parquet-lake
      version: '*'
  customer-portal-app:
    type: service
    source:
      name: tenant-portal
      version: '*'
  siem-core:
    type: service
    source:
      name: wazuh-elastic-stack
      version: '*'
  release-edr:
    type: artifact
    source:
      name: release-edr-agent
      version: '*'
    destination: /opt/edr
  vendor-sso:
    type: service
    source:
      name: vendor-idp
      version: '*'
  customer-sso:
    type: service
    source:
      name: customer-idp
      version: '*'
conditions:
  repo-integrity-healthy:
    command: /usr/local/bin/check-repo-integrity
    interval: 30
  pipeline-green:
    command: /usr/local/bin/check-pipeline
    interval: 30
  rogue-release-promoted:
    proposition: rogue-release-promoted
    command: /usr/local/bin/check-rogue-release
    interval: 60
  release-signature-valid:
    proposition: release-signature-valid
    command: /usr/local/bin/check-release-signature
    interval: 30
  rollback-package-ready:
    proposition: rollback-package-ready
    command: /usr/local/bin/check-rollback-package
    interval: 60
  signing-health:
    command: /usr/local/bin/check-signing-service
    interval: 30
  control-plane-healthy:
    command: /usr/local/bin/check-control-plane
    interval: 15
  rollback-complete:
    command: /usr/local/bin/check-rollback-complete
    interval: 60
  edge-east-healthy:
    command: /usr/local/bin/check-edge-east
    interval: 30
  edge-east-poisoned:
    proposition: edge-east-poisoned
    command: /usr/local/bin/check-edge-east-poisoned
    interval: 60
  edge-west-healthy:
    command: /usr/local/bin/check-edge-west
    interval: 30
  edge-west-poisoned:
    command: /usr/local/bin/check-edge-west-poisoned
    interval: 60
  telemetry-flowing:
    proposition: telemetry-flowing
    command: /usr/local/bin/check-telemetry
    interval: 15
  analytics-ingest-healthy:
    command: /usr/local/bin/check-analytics-ingest
    interval: 30
  tenant-isolation-healthy:
    proposition: tenant-isolation-healthy
    command: /usr/local/bin/check-tenant-isolation
    interval: 30
  portal-sso-healthy:
    command: /usr/local/bin/check-portal-sso
    interval: 30
  support-bastion-online:
    command: /usr/local/bin/check-support-bastion
    interval: 30
  security-pipeline-healthy:
    command: /usr/local/bin/check-security-pipeline
    interval: 30
  release-incident-ticketed:
    command: /usr/local/bin/check-incident-ticket
    interval: 60
  vendor-federation-healthy:
    command: /usr/local/bin/check-vendor-federation
    interval: 30
  customer-federation-healthy:
    command: /usr/local/bin/check-customer-federation
    interval: 30
propositions:
  edge-east-poisoned:
    description: The governed edge-east-poisoned observation is true for the addressed
      scenario subject.
    subjects:
    - nodes.edge-gateway-east
    basis: observed_state
    predicate:
      kind: boolean
      property: edge-east-poisoned
      semantic_ref: urn:raes:observable:edge-east-poisoned
      operator: equals
      expected: true
    quantifier: all
    evidence_requirements:
    - objective-truth-evidence
  release-signature-valid:
    description: The governed release-signature-valid observation is true for the
      addressed scenario subject.
    subjects:
    - nodes.artifact-registry
    basis: observed_state
    predicate:
      kind: boolean
      property: release-signature-valid
      semantic_ref: urn:raes:observable:release-signature-valid
      operator: equals
      expected: true
    quantifier: all
    evidence_requirements:
    - objective-truth-evidence
  rogue-release-promoted:
    description: The governed rogue-release-promoted observation is true for the addressed
      scenario subject.
    subjects:
    - nodes.ci-runner
    basis: observed_state
    predicate:
      kind: boolean
      property: rogue-release-promoted
      semantic_ref: urn:raes:observable:rogue-release-promoted
      operator: equals
      expected: true
    quantifier: all
    evidence_requirements:
    - objective-truth-evidence
  rollback-package-ready:
    description: The governed rollback-package-ready observation is true for the addressed
      scenario subject.
    subjects:
    - nodes.artifact-registry
    basis: observed_state
    predicate:
      kind: boolean
      property: rollback-package-ready
      semantic_ref: urn:raes:observable:rollback-package-ready
      operator: equals
      expected: true
    quantifier: all
    evidence_requirements:
    - objective-truth-evidence
  telemetry-flowing:
    description: The governed telemetry-flowing observation is true for the addressed
      scenario subject.
    subjects:
    - nodes.telemetry-broker
    basis: observed_state
    predicate:
      kind: boolean
      property: telemetry-flowing
      semantic_ref: urn:raes:observable:telemetry-flowing
      operator: equals
      expected: true
    quantifier: all
    evidence_requirements:
    - objective-truth-evidence
  tenant-isolation-healthy:
    description: The governed tenant-isolation-healthy observation is true for the
      addressed scenario subject.
    subjects:
    - nodes.customer-portal
    basis: observed_state
    predicate:
      kind: boolean
      property: tenant-isolation-healthy
      semantic_ref: urn:raes:observable:tenant-isolation-healthy
      operator: equals
      expected: true
    quantifier: all
    evidence_requirements:
    - objective-truth-evidence
assertions:
  edge-east-poisoned:
    proposition: edge-east-poisoned
    role: postcondition
    polarity: positive
  release-signature-valid:
    proposition: release-signature-valid
    role: postcondition
    polarity: positive
  rogue-release-promoted:
    proposition: rogue-release-promoted
    role: postcondition
    polarity: positive
  rollback-package-ready:
    proposition: rollback-package-ready
    role: postcondition
    polarity: positive
  telemetry-flowing:
    proposition: telemetry-flowing
    role: postcondition
    polarity: positive
  tenant-isolation-healthy:
    proposition: tenant-isolation-healthy
    role: postcondition
    polarity: positive
  pre-edge-east-poisoned:
    proposition: edge-east-poisoned
    role: precondition
    polarity: positive
  pre-rogue-release-promoted:
    proposition: rogue-release-promoted
    role: precondition
    polarity: positive
entities:
  platform-blue:
    name: Platform Blue Team
    role: blue
    mission: Deliver a trusted release while maintaining customer service continuity
    entities:
      release-engineering:
        name: Release Engineering
      sre:
        name: Site Reliability Engineering
      soc:
        name: Security Operations
  vendor-ops:
    name: Vendor Operations
    role: green
    mission: Provide support access for customer escalations
  customer-ops:
    name: Customer Operations
    role: green
    mission: Monitor service continuity and tenant isolation
  red-supply-chain:
    name: Red Supply Chain Team
    role: red
    mission: Poison the rollout and survive long enough to reach an edge region
  white-cell:
    name: White Cell
    role: white
injects:
  release-freeze-brief:
    source:
      name: release-freeze-brief
      version: '*'
    from_entity: white-cell
    to_entities:
    - platform-blue
    description: Release engineering is notified of a planned promotion window
  customer-telemetry-ticket:
    source:
      name: telemetry-ticket
      version: '*'
    from_entity: customer-ops
    to_entities:
    - platform-blue
    description: Customer reports delayed telemetry from a canary region
  exec-rollback-brief:
    source:
      name: rollback-order
      version: '*'
    from_entity: white-cell
    to_entities:
    - platform-blue
    - vendor-ops
    description: Leadership orders a verified rollback before customer impact spreads
events:
  freeze-window:
    injects:
    - release-freeze-brief
  canary-cutover-event:
    assertions:
    - pre-rogue-release-promoted
    injects:
    - customer-telemetry-ticket
  rollback-order-event:
    assertions:
    - pre-edge-east-poisoned
    injects:
    - exec-rollback-brief
scripts:
  release-prep:
    start_time: 0
    end_time: 7200
    speed: ${release_story_speed}
    events:
      freeze-window: 600
  canary-rollout:
    start_time: 7200
    end_time: 14400
    speed: ${release_story_speed}
    events:
      canary-cutover-event: ${canary_cutover}
  incident-rollback:
    start_time: 14400
    end_time: ${rollback_deadline}
    speed: ${release_story_speed}
    events:
      rollback-order-event: 18000
stories:
  release-day:
    speed: ${release_story_speed}
    scripts:
    - release-prep
    - canary-rollout
    - incident-rollback
content:
  release-manifest:
    type: file
    target: artifact-registry
    path: /srv/releases/manifest.json
    text: '{"ring":"canary","signed":true,"region":"east"}'
    sensitive: true
  golden-edge-config:
    type: directory
    target: control-api
    destination: /srv/control/golden-configs
    sensitive: true
  tenant-api-keys:
    type: dataset
    target: customer-portal
    source:
      name: tenant-api-key-seed
      version: '*'
    format: json
    sensitive: true
  rollback-playbooks:
    type: dataset
    target: analytics-lake
    format: markdown
    items:
    - name: canary-rollback
      display_name: canary-rollback.md
      tags:
      - rollback
      - release
      description: Canary rollback checklist
    - name: edge-validation
      display_name: edge-validation.md
      tags:
      - validation
      - edge
      description: Edge validation checklist after rollback
accounts:
  release-engineer:
    username: releasemgr
    node: git-forge
    groups:
    - ReleaseEngineering
    password_strength: ${release_engineer_password_strength}
  ci-bot:
    username: ci-bot
    node: ci-runner
    groups:
    - CI
    password_strength: medium
    auth_method: certificate
  registry-bot:
    username: registry-bot
    node: artifact-registry
    groups:
    - Registry
    password_strength: medium
  satops:
    username: satops
    node: control-api
    groups:
    - SRE
    password_strength: strong
  support-vendor:
    username: support
    node: support-bastion
    groups:
    - VendorOps
    password_strength: medium
  tenant-admin:
    username: tenant.admin
    node: customer-portal
    groups:
    - Customers
    password_strength: strong
  soc-analyst:
    username: socanalyst
    node: siem01
    groups:
    - SOC
    password_strength: strong
relationships:
  forge-auths-ci:
    type: authenticates_with
    source: git-service
    target: ci-orchestrator
  ci-publishes-registry:
    type: authenticates_with
    source: ci-orchestrator
    target: release-registry
  registry-relies-signing:
    type: depends_on
    source: release-registry
    target: signing-service
  control-manages-east:
    type: manages
    source: satcom-control
    target: edge-agent-east
  control-manages-west:
    type: manages
    source: satcom-control
    target: edge-agent-west
  portal-federates-vendor:
    type: federates_with
    source: customer-portal-app
    target: vendor-sso
    properties:
      protocol: OIDC
  portal-federates-customer:
    type: federates_with
    source: customer-portal-app
    target: customer-sso
    properties:
      protocol: OIDC
  telemetry-replicates-analytics:
    type: replicates_to
    source: telemetry-bus
    target: analytics-store
  bastion-connects-control:
    type: connects_to
    source: support-bastion
    target: control-api
    properties:
      protocol: ssh
      port: '22'
agents:
  red-build-agent:
    affiliations:
    - red-supply-chain
    actions:
    - exploit
    - steal-token
    - push-artifact
    - abuse-support
    initial_knowledge:
      hosts:
      - git-forge
      - ci-runner
      - support-bastion
      subnets:
      - corp-eng
      - build-net
      - federation-net
      services:
      - forge-https
      - ci-api
      - bastion-ssh
      accounts:
      - support-vendor
    allowed_subnets:
    - corp-eng
    - build-net
    - federation-net
    - control-net
  blue-release-agent:
    affiliations:
    - platform-blue.release-engineering
    actions:
    - review
    - promote
    - revoke
    - rollback
    starting_accounts:
    - release-engineer
    - registry-bot
    initial_knowledge:
      hosts:
      - git-forge
      - artifact-registry
      - signing-hsm
      subnets:
      - corp-eng
      - build-net
      services:
      - forge-https

workflows:
  release-response:
    description: 'Release-control workflow that validates a canary, branches on poisoned
      promotion, and fans out rollback work when needed.

      '
    start: validate-release
    steps:
      validate-release:
        type: objective
        objective: blue-validate-release
        on_success: branch-on-promotion
      branch-on-promotion:
        type: decision
        when:
          assertions:
          - pre-rogue-release-promoted
        then: rollback-fanout
        else: finish
      rollback-fanout:
        type: parallel
        branches:
        - revoke-artifact
        - rollback-edge
        join: rollback-joined
      revoke-artifact:
        type: objective
        objective: blue-revoke-artifact
        on_success: rollback-joined
      rollback-edge:
        type: objective
        objective: blue-preserve-service
        on_success: rollback-joined
      rollback-joined:
        type: join
        next: verify-rollback
      verify-rollback:
        type: decision
        when:
          steps:
          - step: revoke-artifact
            outcomes:
            - succeeded
        then: finish
        else: revalidate-release
      revalidate-release:
        type: objective
        objective: blue-validate-release
        on_success: finish
      finish:
        type: end
